description:
Create a new GeoPackage LineString layer and digitize a route connecting specific points using snapping.

1. Open QGIS (it will start with sample points loaded).
2. Create a new GeoPackage layer named 'power_line.gpkg' in '/home/ga/GIS_Data/'. Set Geometry type to 'LineString' and CRS to EPSG:4326 (WGS 84).
3. Enable the Snapping Toolbar (Project > Snapping Options > Enable Snapping). Ensure it is set to snap to Vertex.
4. Toggle editing on your new 'power_line' layer and select the 'Add Line Feature' tool.
5. Digitize a SINGLE line connecting 'Point A' -> 'Point B' -> 'Point C' (in that order). You MUST wait for the snapping indicator (magenta square) on each point before clicking to ensure exact connectivity.
6. Right-click to finish the feature.
7. Save layer edits and save the project.
